title: Freshness-gated build package materializer
goal: Materialize a non-executing build package only when an admitted build request is still fresh against current MISSING_WORK preflight and the same local route.
laws: Recompute preflight immediately before package materialization.
NO_CHANGE or BLOCKED makes any older build request stale and unusable.
Recompute the route and require the exact builder and route digest admitted by Trust Canal.
Package is immutable evidence only; it grants no authority and starts no worker.
Package carries canonical mission objective, selected builder, route digest and request receipt.
Replay is idempotent; conflicts fail closed.
